items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Which is kind of how Ray was referring to as well. [INTERVIEWEE] Probably he was talking about the same thing, yea.

ctx.x: Yea, and I tried to do the best, because many, many Jazz artist—and I also put classical in there—they had been incorporating the elements in a very irresponsible way. Without, in order to mix one thing with another, you have to know the elements of both sides, you know. Pay respect to the music and all.
Which is kind of how Ray was referring to as well.
Probably he was talking about the same thing, yea. In order to want an element to a certain style of music, you have to learn the most that you can from that style of music.
